issues.detail: The Greek 'οι προσκοπτουσιν τω λογω απειθουντες' describes the people as those who 'disobey/do not believe the word' (the cause of their stumbling). The Vietnamese translation 'họ vấp ngã vì không vâng phục lời' implies they fell *because* they didn't obey, whereas the Greek structure identifies them as those who disobey the word and are thus a stumbling block.
